description: Declarative, file-agnostic context bundling configuration for packaging RFC-LLM source code, executables, tests, domain knowledge, and architectural specifications into plain-text Markdown bundles optimized for Gemini and LLM Notebook ingestion.

bundles.name: 00_ARCHITECTURE_AND_INDEX.md
bundles.title: RFC-LLM Master Index, Architecture & Project Configuration
bundles.description: Tier 1 — Master repository index, executive Gemini ingestion guide, delta changelog since last sync, automated AST symbol and CLI script registry, heavy/binary asset inventory, architecture specifications, and root project configuration manifests.

bundles.name: 01_CORE_SOURCE_AND_CLI.md
bundles.title: RFC-LLM Core Source Code, Compilers, IR & CLI Entrypoints
bundles.description: Tier 2 — Complete core synthesis pipeline (`src/`), including RFC document ingestion, order-sorted message algebra intermediate representation (IR), constrained protocol extraction, CPSA 4.4.9 JSON/Scheme code generation, roletran & compiler self-healing verification engine, live web visualizer, root `rfc-llm` CLI entrypoint, and the benchmark EDHOC input RFC.
bundles.tier: Tier 2 — Core Source Code & CLI Entrypoints

bundles.name: 02_RAG_SCRIPTS_AND_TESTS.md
bundles.title: Operational RAG Scripts, Evaluation Harnesses & Test Suites
bundles.description: Tier 3 — Operational RAG chunking/embedding/enrichment pipeline scripts (`refrences/scripts/`), shell pipeline runner (`refrences/run_rag_pipeline.sh`), retrieval evaluation and clustering scripts (`refrences/reports/`), LaTeX report source, and the complete pytest unit and integration test suite (`tests/`).
bundles.tier: Tier 3 — Operational Scripts, Pipelines & Test Suites

bundles.name: 03_CPSA_DOMAIN_KNOWLEDGE_AND_GUIDES.md
bundles.title: CPSA 4.4.9 Domain Modeling References, Manuals & Guides
bundles.description: Tier 1/3 Domain Reference — Curated CPSA 4.4.9 protocol modeling skill definitions, complete official MITRE User Manual and Specification, grammar and roletran references, Dolev-Yao theoretical guides, and transcribed CPSA documentation.
bundles.tier: Tier 1/3 — Domain Reference Documentation & Modeling Guides

bundles.name: 04_CPSA_SCM_EXAMPLES_CORPUS.md
bundles.title: Official MITRE CPSA Scheme (.scm) Protocol Examples Corpus
bundles.description: Tier 3 Reference Corpus — Complete collection of 148 official MITRE CPSA `.scm` protocol specifications, heralds, macros, defroles, and security goals used for few-shot RAG grounding and grammar verification.

summarized_assets.description: Tier 4 — Heavy, binary, compiled or duplicated artifacts excluded from raw text dumping and summarized with metadata, line/record counts, and lightweight schema previews.
